lines.t: Six days for the work.
Seventh set apart.
We don’t switch the day.
We don’t shut our hearts.
Shabbat shalom.
Let it shake.
Shabbat shalom—BOOM, let it knock!
Seventh day holy, put the work on stop.
Saturday Sabbath—no switch, no swap!
Rest from the grind, but the love don’t stop.
Shabbat shalom—bass down low!
Hands off the hustle, let the mercy show.
Shabbat shalom—bass down low!
Hands off the hustle, let the mercy show.
Six days deep with the weight on my back,
Seventh comes round, ain’t chasing that stack.
Phone goes quiet, put the deals on ice,
Can’t buy holy with a bigger price.
Whole world saying, “Get more, don’t quit,”
I don’t bow to the clock, I don’t live for a shift.
Got a day set apart that I won’t trade in,
Shut the shop, drop the load, let the rest begin.
Not a spare little slot when the week runs dry,
Not a word on a shirt while the day slips by.
We remember the seventh, we honor the call,
Saturday Sabbath, standing tall.
Sunday ain’t the Sabbath that we’re here to keep,
Let the kick hit hard, let the word cut deep.
He does not change—that’s the truth we proclaim,
We won’t move that mark just to fit the game.
No switch.
No swap.
Work down.
Clock stopped.
Heart open.
Door unlocked.
Love don’t stop.
Shabbat shalom—BOOM, let it knock!
Seventh day holy, put the work on stop.
Saturday Sabbath—no switch, no swap!
Rest from the grind, but the love don’t stop.
Shabbat shalom—bass down low!
Hands off the hustle, let the mercy show.
Don’t talk holy, leave a child outside,
Big words mean little with a cold heart inside.
Fatherless kid needs somebody there,
Not another closed door, not an empty prayer.
Widow at home with a cupboard bare,
Take a bag to the porch, put some food right there.
Neighbor needs help? We don’t walk on past,
Won’t use our rest as a cold-heart mask.
Do good—that’s the work we defend,
Lift that weight, let a broken heart mend.
No price on the plate, no debt for the bread,
No camera rolling when the table gets set.
Not a day He replaced, not a change He declared—
That’s the word we were given, that’s the stand we share.
Seventh day sacred, compassion stays live,
Put the grind on pause , let the kindness rise.
What good is the quiet
If we won’t hear the cry?
What good is a full plate
With a hungry child outside?
We lay down the labor—
Not the love, not the care.
Keep the seventh holy.
Put the mercy there.
Shabbat shalom—BOOM, let it knock!
Seventh day holy, put the work on stop.
Saturday Sabbath—no switch, no swap!
Rest from the grind, but the love don’t stop.
Shabbat shalom—bass down low!
Hands off the hustle, let the mercy show.
No switch.
No swap.
Seventh day.
Work stops.
Hands out.
Hearts strong.
Shabbat…
Shalom.
